card.name: Words right before a drug's effect
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, an, to, that) or verbs like increased and prolong, right after a drug is said to cause, reduce or change something. The next word is likely an effect such as increase, decrease or change.

modes.label: Article after cause
modes.description: The word a or an after a verb like cause, causes or had, just before a named effect.
modes.example: CNS stimulants cause<< an>> increase in blood pressure (mean increase about

modes.label: Linking word before effect verb
modes.description: The word to or that after shown or demonstrated, leading into what the drug does.
modes.example: Oral contraceptives have been shown<< to>> cause a decrease in glucose tolerance in a

modes.label: Effect verb itself
modes.description: A verb of change such as increased or prolong that names the drug's action.
modes.example: A 100 mg dose of quinidine<< increased>> steady state concentrations of propafenone

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning change or effect, such as 改变, effect and 作用.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says what a drug changes or causes.
